name: Independent verification of references and NDA-covered experience

attribution.legal_posture: Source-qualified defensive abstraction only. The stated evidence class covers a defensive abstraction; legal identity, nationality, employer compromise, prevalence rate, and adjudicated fact require separate sources.

caveats: Fraudulent employment and fake-interview malware remain separate analytic tracks absent explicit same-case evidence.
NDA work is common and carries ordinary confidentiality context; suspicion requires separate evidence.
The record excludes people, personas, accounts, companies, victims, images, contact details, payment selectors, credentials, raw network indicators, and leaked material.

Accent, ethnicity, nationality, appearance, location, camera or audio quality, productivity level, consumer email, shipping change, meeting feature, and technical anomaly are contextual signals; fraud or DPRK attribution requires independent evidence.
The transcript's company-name rendering is omitted because auto-caption spelling and corporate attribution were not independently verified.
Use behavior and continuity signals only in combination with independent verification, consistently applied human review, least privilege, and an appeal or correction path.

statements: Raney says the operation inflated his GIS experience, inserted employment at a company he attributed to the operation, and used supposed NDA-bound contract work to explain experience absent from his public history. He notes that an operator-controlled employer could answer a reference check and validate the fabricated projects.
Do not rely on a single employer-provided reference; independently verify the employer's age, operations, staff history, contact channels, and project footprint.
Ask for non-sensitive, falsifiable detail about claimed NDA work and corroborate skills through live, changing tasks rather than résumé claims.
limitations: The transcript's company-name rendering is not retained because auto-caption spelling and corporate attribution were not independently verified.
NDA work is common and is not itself suspicious.

statements: Retain the source's observation class and do not generalize a controlled test, speaker claim, vendor sample, or demonstration into measured prevalence.
